Definition: from G4253; leaning (falling) forward ("prone"), i.e. head foremost:--headlong.
BiblicalUsage: Prenes means headlong, falling forward, head foremost. Luke uses it once, for Judas: falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fall of Judas is the end of a road chosen step by step, and the word headlong says how fast the end comes.
